title: clopen_first_four
statement:
theorem clopen_first_four (Λ : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing Λ]
    {k : Type u} [Field k] [IsAlgClosed k] {X : Scheme.{u}}
    (f : X ⟶ Spec (.of k)) [IsCurve f] (M : ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ)
    {ι : Type u} [Finite ι] (U : ι → X.Opens)
    (hU : ∀ i, IsClosed (U i : Set X))
    (hdisj : Pairwise (fun i j ↦ Disjoint (U i : Set X) (U j)))
    (hcov : ∀ x : X, ∃ i, x ∈ U i)
    (H : ∀ i, Assertions Λ ((U i).ι ≫ f)
      ((constantSheaf (U i).toScheme.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ)).obj M)) :
    VanishingAboveTwo Λ ((constantSheaf X.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ)).obj M) ∧
    VanishingAboveOneOfIsAffine Λ ((constantSheaf X.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ)).obj M) ∧
    VanishingAboveOneOfIsPrimaryTorsionSheaf Λ ((constantSheaf X.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ)).obj M) k ∧
    FiniteOfInvertibleOrder Λ ((constantSheaf X.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ)).obj M) k

source.place: Proof, first paragraph: finite disjoint unions commute with every map under consideration

proof.text: The pairwise disjoint open immersions cover X, so Mathlib nonempty_isColimit_cofanMk_of supplies their coproduct cocone. Compare restriction of the underlying constant module sheaf with the underlying constant sheaf on each piece using constantCommuteCompose and upperStarConstantSheafIso. Finite-coproduct cohomology assembly then gives bijective product coordinates in every degree.

For q > 2 the component C1 assertions make every coordinate group a subsingleton; injectivity of the product coordinates proves C1 on X. If X is affine, each clopen inclusion is a closed immersion, hence an affine morphism, so each piece is affine (Mathlib isAffine_of_isAffineHom). The component C2 assertions and the same injection prove C2.

Identify the stalk of each constant module sheaf on a piece with the original constant module stalk at the composite geometric point, using upperStarCompSheafFiberIso and the constant-sheaf pullback isomorphism. The linear isomorphism transports annihilation by powers of p. Apply component C3, then injectivity of product coordinates.

Constructibility pulls back and is invariant under the constant-sheaf restriction isomorphism. The same stalk linear isomorphism transports an annihilating positive integer whose invertibility is measured on Spec k. Thus component C4 gives finite coordinate groups; their finite dependent product is finite, and the product-coordinate injection makes the cohomology of X finite.
